items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: I mean, you got to remember the Hawk. You stole everything, man.

ctx.x: I have a good gig in this room.
And... ...the man. I mean, you got to remember the Hawk. You stole everything, man. Now we could find out who the Hawk was.
You stayed out for a year and then came back? Yeah. Yeah. Who were you with during that year?
